html:
Just minutes from our Cobble Hill location is a place where city life meets open sky. Stretching more than 1.3 miles along the East River, this waterfront park is a favorite for locals who crave a little space to breathe, move, and reconnect. For our Buzzy community, it’s the perfect setting to slow down, recharge, and let inspiration flow.

A Local Oasis Worth Wandering

You’ll find something for every kind of mood at Brooklyn Bridge Park.

  • Piers 1 & 2: Start your day with a coffee stroll or a mellow skate session under the bridge. Pier 2’s courts are always alive with pickup basketball, while Pier 1’s lawns offer wide-open views of the Manhattan skyline—ideal for an afternoon of people-watching or simply unwinding.
  • Jane’s Carousel: Step into a bit of nostalgia at this restored 1922 carousel, right on the Dumbo waterfront. The glass pavilion glows in the sunlight and feels like stepping into another time.
  • Harbor View Lawn: Bring a blanket, your journal, and a low-dose edible, and let the sounds of the river do the rest. It’s one of the best places in Brooklyn to reset your rhythm.
  • Empire Stores & Time Out Market: Refuel with a local bite, browse artisan shops, or catch the sunset from the rooftop terrace—it’s where the neighborhood comes together.
  • Ferry Dock & Greenway Trail: If you’re feeling adventurous, rent a Citi Bike or catch the East River Ferry for a different view of the borough.

Where Cannabis Culture Meets Community

At Buzzy, we believe cannabis is about more than consumption—it’s about connection. Whether you’re a Curious Explorer new to the plant or a Connoisseur who appreciates flavor and craft, the park’s laid-back energy mirrors what we value most: balance, ritual, and curiosity.

Enjoy your stroll along the piers, stop for a mindful moment with CBD mints or a calming pre-roll (in designated smoking areas, of course), and let the city unfold at its own pace. Brooklyn Bridge Park has that rare ability to ground you—proof that wellness doesn’t always happen indoors.

From Court Street to the Waterfront

One of the best parts of our Court Street neighborhood is how seamlessly urban life blends with nature. From Buzzy’s doorstep, you’re just a short walk through Cobble Hill and Brooklyn Heights to the park entrance. You’ll pass historic brownstones, indie cafés, and tree-lined streets that remind you how deeply rooted this part of Brooklyn is in community and creativity.

At Buzzy, we’re proud to be part of that fabric—connecting our neighbors not just to quality cannabis, but to the spaces and rituals that make everyday life a little more inspired.

So next time you stop by Buzzy on Court Street, take your time on the way home. Wander down to Brooklyn Bridge Park, breathe deep, and let the view remind you why you love this city.
